t: 匈奴人阿提拉夺取了法国的默兹,杀死了大部分居民并烧毁了小镇.
te: Attila the Hun captures Metz in France, killing most of its inhabitants and burning the town.
dz: 匈奴人阿提拉夺取了法国的默兹,杀死了大部分居民并烧毁了小镇.
de: Attila the Hun captures Metz in France, killing most of its inhabitants and burning the town.

te: Battle of Avarayr between Armenian rebels and the Sasanian Empire takes place. The Sasanids defeat the Armenians milita…
dz: 亚美尼亚叛军和萨尼安帝国之间的阿瓦赖尔战役正在发生. 萨尼德人在军事上打败了亚美尼亚人,但保证他们有公开信奉基督教的自由.
de: Battle of Avarayr between Armenian rebels and the Sasanian Empire takes place. The Sasanids defeat the Armenians militarily but guarantee them freedom to openly practice Christianity.

te: Flavius Aetius battles Attila the Hun. After the battle, which was inconclusive, Attila retreats. Despite suffering cat…
dz: 查龙斯战役:弗拉维乌斯·艾提乌斯出战匈奴阿提拉. 战役无果后,阿提拉撤退. 尽管遭受了灾难性的损失,导致他们同哥特人的联盟倒闭并摧毁了罗马军队的大部分,但尽管没有任何明显的军事成功,罗马人还是宣布了胜利.
de: Battle of Chalons: Flavius Aetius battles Attila the Hun. After the battle, which was inconclusive, Attila retreats.  Despite suffering catastrophic losses that led to the collapse of their alliance with the Goths and the destruction of much of the Roman army, the Romans nevertheless proclaimed victory despite the lack of any clear military success.

de: The first session of the Council of Chalcedon begins.

de: The Chalcedonian Creed, regarding the divine and human nature of Jesus, is adopted by the Council of Chalcedon, an ecumenical council.
